newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to open unit in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to open unit in Jordan.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Wednesday it will open its first restaurant in Jordan on November 7, making that country the 97th nation in which the fast-food-giant does business.
McDonald's said it expects to be operating in 100 countries by the end of the year.

"McDonald's has experienced very strong growth in the Middle East since we first entered the region three years ago, and our opening in Amman continues this trend," Jim Cantalupo, president of McDonald's International, said in a statement.

McDonald's first entered the Middle East with its grand opening in Israel in 1993. It now has more than 90 restaurants throughout Bahrain, Egypt, Israel, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
